Tonight was a really rough night for me. And it made me understand even more why so many people stay in situations they know are hurting them. Because sometimes leaving isn’t the hardest part. It’s what comes after. Having your experience mocked. Having people turn something that genuinely traumatised you into entertainment. Watching people laugh, make jokes, twist the story or deliberately do things they know will hurt you while you’re still trying to put yourself back together. Sometimes staying feels easier than facing the humiliation and mockery that can come with finally choosing yourself. I don’t regret leaving. Not for a second. But I think people need to understand that leaving doesn’t instantly mean you’re free from the situation emotionally. Sometimes that’s when an entirely different battle begins. Tonight hurt. But I would still choose this difficult road over going back to the person I was becoming just to survive the other one. 🤍 #fyp #healing #dv
